''[…]''»
«It sounds like the ''Bellicose'' was able to intervene before things got out of hand.|[[Patriarch]] [[Clarr'ivl'exow]] and [[Captain]] [[Clarr'os'culry]]|audio=Ersikarosbellicose.flac||translated=1}} '''Csaus''' was an astronomical object located in the territory of the [[Unknown Regions]] government named the [[Chiss Ascendancy]]. The [[Chiss Space]] celestial body was situated in the [[Csaus system]], within grid square F-9 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. In [[18 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places the main events of ''[[Thrawn Ascendancy: Lesser Evil]]'' in [[18 BBY]]. during a [[Grysk plot to engineer a Chiss civil war|crisis]] in the Ascendancy, a [[Battle at Csaus|battle]] was fought at Csaus between the [[Tahmie]] and [[Droc family|Droc]] [[Chiss family|families]], wherein [[Chiss Defense Force]] [[Admiral]] [[Ers'ikaro]]'s [[Firewolf man-of-war]] [[Bellicose (Firewolf man-of-war)|''Bellicose'']] stopped the conflict before it could further escalate. Another [[Skirmish at Csaus|conflict]] took place at Csaus late during the crisis. ==Behind the scenes== In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Csaus was first mentioned in the [[2021]] novel ''[[Thrawn Ascendancy: Lesser Evil]]'', the final volume of the ''[[Star Wars: The Ascendancy Trilogy]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]]. In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Csaus/Legends|Csaus]] was introduced in [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]'s [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' ==Appearances== *''[[Thrawn Ascendancy: Lesser Evil]]'' {{Ab|Thrawn Ascendancy: Lesser Evil (audiobook)}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Csaus}} {{Reflist}} [[Category:Astronomical objects in the Unknown Regions]] [[Category:Chiss Ascendancy astronomical objects]] [[Category:Chiss Space locations]]
